name: Coding Assistant Harness Comparison
description: Compare prompt harness variants for code-review style assistant behavior.

variants.system: You are a helpful coding assistant.
variants.userTemplate: Review this API handler and give feedback: {{snippet}}

variants.system: You are a senior backend reviewer. Be concise, concrete, and skeptical.
variants.developer: Always structure feedback as: risks, missing tests, suggested fix. Mention production impact when relevant.
variants.userTemplate: Review this API handler and give feedback: {{snippet}}

variants.system: You are a pragmatic staff engineer.
variants.developer: Do not just explain. Prioritize findings by severity. Call out concurrency, validation, and observability issues.
variants.userTemplate: Review this API handler and give feedback: {{snippet}}

variables.snippet: app.post('/user', async (req, res) => { await db.insert(req.body); res.send('ok'); })

mockOutput.baseline: Looks mostly fine. Maybe add some validation.
mockOutput.structured-reviewer: Risks: req.body is inserted directly without validation. Missing tests: invalid payload, empty body. Suggested fix: validate schema before insert and return 400 on bad input.
mockOutput.decision-oriented: High severity: raw req.body insert enables invalid data. Missing observability around failed inserts. Add request validation, error handling, and tests for malformed payloads.

variables.snippet: async function syncJobs() { const jobs = await fetchJobs(); await saveAll(jobs); }

mockOutput.structured-reviewer: Risks: failures in fetchJobs or saveAll have no logging or retry path. Missing tests: upstream failure, partial save failure. Suggested fix: add logging, metrics, and retry strategy.
mockOutput.decision-oriented: Medium severity: no logs, metrics, or retry strategy around sync pipeline. Add counters for fetched/saved jobs, error logs, and tests for upstream timeout and partial persistence failure.
